# TPC-Havoc Q14_v8

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  100.00 * SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN EXISTS(
        SELECT
          1
        FROM part AS p2
        WHERE
          p2.p_partkey = l.l_partkey AND p2.p_type LIKE 'PROMO%'
      )
      THEN l.l_extendedprice * (
        1 - l.l_discount
      )
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) / SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (
    1 - l.l_discount
  )) AS promo_revenue
FROM lineitem AS l
WHERE
  l.l_shipdate >= CAST('1995-09-01' AS DATE)
  AND l.l_shipdate < CAST('1995-09-01' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH'
  AND EXISTS(
    SELECT
      1
    FROM part AS p
    WHERE
      p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey
  )
```
